answer: Proof of Work provides robust Sybil resistance by tying identity to computational expenditure. An AI agent must perform a complex task, metaphorically sharpening its quill to solve cryptographic puzzles, which isolates each participant as an island of verifiable effort. By requiring an opal of energy consumption to validate a transaction, the system forces attackers to incur prohibitive costs, as generating multiple fake identities necessitates proportional hardware investment that renders mass subversion economically irrational.
